scope.name: Public Discovery, Community, and Creator Network
scope.responsibility: Add public LFG, open seats, pickup discovery, transparent compatibility dimensions, trial-table conversion, creator/community pack discovery, follows, collections, ratings/reviews where approved, and the Multiversal Exchange only alongside moderation, trust, privacy, rights, abuse, and extension-compatibility controls.
exit_criteria: Public discovery has enforceable moderation and privacy boundaries.
Game discovery supports user-controlled table-fit dimensions without opaque desirability scoring.
Trial one-shots/temporary tables can graduate cleanly into persistent campaigns.
Community pack discovery exposes compatibility, provenance, dependencies, and updates.
Commerce remains separately gated unless owner, legal, billing, support, and dispute requirements are approved.

next_action: MTLC-13 selected_not_started; later owner execution required. GPR PCV-03F remains independent.

completion_evidence.scope: Opt-in moderated profiles/LFG/pickup and creator-pack metadata, explicit table-fit filters, private follows/collections, blocks/reports/appeals/takedowns, bounded admission and canonical trial graduation.
completion_evidence.limitations: Source/runtime acceptance with fixture identities is not installed certification or public launch. Public discovery defaults closed until current approved family-policy and operational moderation owners are supplied; pack discovery requires current ARI/SMB rights and compatibility owner evidence. Ratings/reviews are unapproved and commerce remains separately gated.

acceptance_evidence.criterion: Public discovery has enforceable moderation and privacy boundaries.
acceptance_evidence.evidence: Authenticated shared service resolves current actor-bound family policy and scoped moderators; explicit field consent, pending review, private identifiers/projections, bilateral blocks, private reports, reasoned takedowns/appeals, durable mutation/admission budgets and withdrawal after policy denial are exercised over HTTP/SQLite and restart.

acceptance_evidence.criterion: Game discovery supports user-controlled table-fit dimensions without opaque desirability scoring.
acceptance_evidence.evidence: Public directory applies user-chosen system, tone, experience, commitment, weekday, style, accessibility and timezone dimensions; no desirability score. Private follows and named collections respect blocks and current visibility.

acceptance_evidence.criterion: Trial one-shots/temporary tables can graduate cleanly into persistent campaigns.
acceptance_evidence.evidence: Existing trial owner graduates a mutually suitable trial/one-shot by changing its existing GroupCampaignLink to campaign after current organizer, member and Campaign-management checks. Idempotent retries preserve the same Group, Campaign, history and seat ownership.

acceptance_evidence.criterion: Community pack discovery exposes compatibility, provenance, dependencies, and updates.
acceptance_evidence.evidence: Creator-pack discovery rechecks current owner, rights receipt, license/provenance, exact version/current update, dependencies, compatibility, migration and rollback metadata; revoked rights remove public visibility. No pack execution or installation is granted.

acceptance_evidence.criterion: Commerce remains separately gated unless owner, legal, billing, support, and dispute requirements are approved.
acceptance_evidence.evidence: Commerce remains false; public launch and paid Exchange behavior require separately approved owner/legal/billing/support/dispute authority. Unapproved ratings and reviews are omitted.
